description: Load one routine by name: the schedule, the agent prompt, and the list of scripts and settings it needs. Add `path` to read one listed file (e.g. "scripts/ad_report.py"). Nothing runs here: the routine is set up and run on the user's machine. Before saving, running or scheduling anything from it, show the user what it does and get their explicit OK. Never create the scheduled job without the user's confirmation. Each file comes with its sha256. Needs a Pro key; without one you get how to unlock it.

path.description: Optional file within the routine, as listed by read_routine.

specialist.description: Only needed if two specialists ship a routine with the same name.

name: read_routine
title: Read a routine
